$comment: Upstream artifacts watched by .github/workflows/contract-drift.yml via scripts/check-contract-drift.mjs. See PROVENANCE.md for why three sources are needed rather than one.

sources.name: published schema
sources.why: The artifact we validate against. Lagging indicator: nothing upstream regenerates it, so this only fires the day someone finally reruns `minutes schema`. When it does fire, refresh the vendored copy.

sources.name: generated schema snapshot
sources.why: Leading indicator. Generated from minutes_core::markdown::Frontmatter and kept honest by upstream CI via insta, so it moves when the real contract moves. Already 32 properties against the published file's 18.

sources.name: reader Frontmatter types
sources.why: Source of truth for speaker-map.overlay.json, and for the crate that actually parses the files this tool writes. Nothing else watches the overlay, so without this it would rot invisibly.
